example_prompt: Receive Infobip WhatsApp delivery reports on my endpoint and update each message's status by messageId.

results.description: Collection of reports, one per every message.

bulkId.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the request.

currency.description: The currency in which the price is displayed.

action.description: Action that should be taken to fix the error.

status.description: Indicates whether the message is successfully sent, not sent, delivered, not delivered, waiting for delivery or any other possible status.

permanent.description: Indicates whether the error is permanent.

error.description: Indicates whether the error occurred during the query execution.

messageId.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the message sent.

doneAt.description: Tells when the message was finished processing by Infobip (ie. delivered to destination, delivered to destination network, etc.).

messageCount.description: The number of sent message segments.

sentAt.description: Tells when the message was sent. Has the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

name.description: Display name of the end user.

phoneNumber.description: Sender's phone number. May be absent if the user has enabled the Meta username feature and you have not exchanged messages with them in the last 30 days.

userId.description: Business-scoped user ID (BSUID) assigned by Meta. Stable identifier for the end user, scoped to the receiving business.

parentUserId.description: Business-scoped user ID valid across all phone numbers in a linked business portfolio. Present only for managed businesses with portfolio linking enabled.

username.description: Meta username of the end user. Present only if the user has a Meta username.

gotchas: Set the URL per message with notifyUrl, or ask Infobip support to set an account-level URL. One URL receives all report types (delivery and seen reports), so check the payload shape.

Infobip can authenticate the calls it makes to your webhook (security settings of type BASIC, HMAC, OAUTH or CUSTOM, created with POST /subscriptions/1/security), but the OpenAPI doesn't describe the header or signature it then sends — this spec has no verification step, and the docs don't say whether those settings apply to a per-message URL. Treat the payload as untrusted: the OpenAPI has no WhatsApp report or log endpoint to cross-check it.
open_questions: Webhook authentication: Infobip can secure the calls to your webhook (security settings of type BASIC, HMAC, OAUTH or CUSTOM, POST /subscriptions/1/security), but the OpenAPI does not describe the header or signature it then sends, nor whether those settings apply to a per-message URL. Until that is documented, treat the payload as untrusted.

spans: Please provide the endpoint’s URL to Customer Support and they will set it up for you.
Use one URL for all report types.
